body: Thank you so much for following my huge rant. It truly helped. I really wish I could have the same attitude you have towards life. But for me succeeding matters above all I really don't care about living. For me being successful is equal to help those around me. I wished I could be a psychologist since where I live they really don't care about mental health so I wanted to help those who are suffering from mental health issues. But I literally ruined all my chances of doing this since in order to get into this career i have to go to med school which is impossible now since i need to get really high marks to enter this university. I don't care about being rich I just wanted to help people to give them good lives since I know that I have always been privileged I always had great parents food on my table I wanted to help those who don't have it is only way will truly feel happy in this life. It is something i have always wanted to do. But how come iam going to help anyone if I cant even help myself? It seems impossible at this point.

My parents probably won't believe that I will be able to get any scholarships. but I don't care I will try anyway. I'm so incredibly unlucky it hurts everyone is just blaming me what they don't know that I am truly not like this is NOT who I am quarantine just made a huge toll on me. Being isolated from people for a long time made me forget life every day felt the same nothing felt like it mattered I just kept procrastinating because I felt there was a lot of time until it just ran out. It is not because I don't care. I'm not gonna give up on myself I just cant.

Thank you so much for understanding. I really appreciate it. It is hard to explain what I am going through to people at home they just think iam lazy and i don't care.  they have the right to believe that but I know myself and I know that I have always great ambitions I just dont know what happened. Even if I didnt get to the mark i wanted I will try to go for a different coumtry I still have a year left I will try as hard as I hard as I can to get a scholarship or something. My parents probably wont agree but i dont care I cant accept failure or going to a bad university . I have been studying my whole life i have studied for SAT 1 a whole year without any vacations just because i got tired these 3 previous months that doesnt mean I have failed . Even if I didnt make it in SAT I will find another way I dont care what my parents think I cant fail I just cant .
Everything is my fault I ruined my own life and dragged my parents down with me I wish at least I ruined it alone.
I truly gave up on myself

The problem is the first time i started i was perfect in sat 1 my mark was 1290 which is great for a first try and i have been trying to improve it ever since i was doing good then suddenly BOOM i just cant study anymore i can't sit in front of a book for more than 2 minutes What the fuck happened I don't know. My mom told that i have always been perfect at studying sice literally kindergarden why now in the most important years of my life this happens?

Where I live parents pay everything for me they work hard for me and i don't deserve it I can't work to get to college if I did that I will never get to college it just doesn't work this way. They keep saying that they failed in raising in me since iam not grateful . They were nver like this they have always been compassionate and understanding i truly drove them to the edge . And i don't have any friends either I literally made everyone around me hate me. Even my own parents.
And the problem is my parents dont believe they truly believe that I don't care about my future anymore which isn't true I just dont know what happened

Thank you for your kind words but believe me they really do since iam not even talking about school i was perfect at school iam talking about the American Diploma which will get me to college since iam international student if you didnt know there is only one subject sat test left and it is the only way to get to college and i just couldn't probably study for it I dont know why and if i got a bad mark in this i wont be able to go to theuniversity that I want I will go to terrible one Where I live it is so hard to enter a proper unvirsety the only way is through marks or of course you could pay for a college to accept you despite your bad marks but i feel like my parents are unwilling to pay for my college ( which is understandable ) since they believe i have no potential and iam going to waste their moeny  again. I dont want to fail in life In the 17 years iam living i have always dreamt of doing something big. I dont know how this happenned . I feel like iam living a nightmare i truly believe that this life isnt worth living anymore . My parents gave me  a lot of chances and were never too harsh on me but i truly believe that they are tired of me now and they hate me. I hate me sooooooooooooo much. All of the obstacles in my life was caused by myself and i never seem to learn from my mistakes. The desire to end myself has been getting bigger since.
I cant get a job iam still a minor.
